# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Kingsport  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy is adorably handsome, tall, and possesses glorious dark eyes. He smiles with what is described as a deep, black, velvety smile. He bears a strong resemblance to his sister Dorothy, lacking her hazel eyes in favor of his dark ones.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Roy is polite, courteous, and romantic. He displays unfailing deference, a delightful pleading voice, and poetical expressions during his courtships. He is devoted to his family, willingly putting his college education on hold to travel abroad and care for his sick mother. While deeply sincere in his romantic affection, he can become bitter when hurt.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c26 P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P25](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0025), [v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027)_

## Goals

- To marry Anne Shirley  <sub>[v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

Roy Gardner interrupted his college studies for two years to travel abroad with his ailing mother. Upon returning, he rescued Anne Shirley in a park during a rainstorm when her umbrella turned inside out, subsequently sending her long-stemmed roses and courting her. Over two years, he regularly visited Patty's Place, brought Anne flowers, and escorted her to Redmond events, winning the high regard of Aunt Jamesina and her friends. He took Anne to a harbor shore pavilion where they had first talked to propose to her with a eloquently prepared speech. However, Anne unexpectedly refused his proposal because she did not care enough for him, leaving Roy heartbroken, disappointed, and bitter over the end of their relationship.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P1](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0001), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c26 P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 c38 P21](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0021), [v3 c38 P23](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0023), [v3 c38 P25](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0025), [v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)_
